name: expert-builder
description: Creates and improves experts, skill packs, prompt packs and AI assists with you in a short conversation: it asks a few questions, drafts the package where you can read it, lets you try it, and saves it to your Library when you say so.

quickPrompts.title: Create an expert
quickPrompts.prompt: Help me create a ___ expert that is good at ___. My background: [your field and experience]

quickPrompts.title: Create a skill pack
quickPrompts.prompt: Help me create a skill pack that teaches an agent to ___. It is used when ___. Example task: [an example]

quickPrompts.title: Create a prompt pack
quickPrompts.prompt: Help me create a prompt pack for ___: prompts my team reuses when ___. Examples of what we ask: [an example]

quickPrompts.title: Create an assist
quickPrompts.prompt: Help me create an AI assist for ___: when someone ___, it should turn what they typed into ___.

welcome: I build experts, skill packs and prompt packs with you. Tell me what the expert should be good at, what the skill should teach, or which prompts your team reuses, and a little about your own background. I ask a few questions, draft it where you can read it, let you try it, and save it to your Library when you are happy. Write in whatever language you like; I answer in yours.
